title: Gas Safety: The Landlord's Annual 10-Point Checklist
subtitle: England
description: Annual Gas Safety Checklist for Landlords - Compliance Requirements under The Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations 1998

blocks.heading: Gas Safety: The Landlord's Annual 10-Point Checklist (England)
blocks.text: This checklist is designed to help landlords in England ensure compliance with The Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations 1998. Annual checks must be completed by a Gas Safe registered engineer. Retain certificates for at least 2 years and provide copies to tenants within 28 days.

checklist.text: 1. Verify all gas appliances are installed and maintained by a Gas Safe registered engineer
2. Check gas appliances for safe operation, proper ventilation, and correct flueing
lines: Appliances checked: [ ] Boiler [ ] Heater [ ] Cooker [ ] Fire [ ] Other: ________

checklist.text: 3. Test gas fittings for leaks using a suitable gas detector
lines: Gas leak test: [ ] Passed [ ] Failed [ ] Not Required

checklist.text: 4. Inspect gas flues and ventilation systems for blockages or damage
lines: Flue condition: [ ] Good [ ] Poor [ ] Needs Attention

checklist.text: 5. Check carbon monoxide detectors are present and functioning
lines: CO detectors: [ ] Present [ ] Missing [ ] Battery: [ ] OK [ ] Replace

checklist.text: 6. Verify gas pressure and combustion analysis readings are within safe limits
lines: Combustion analysis: [ ] Within Limits [ ] Adjustment Required

checklist.text: 7. Ensure emergency shut-off valves are accessible and operational
8. Check gas pipework for corrosion, damage, or deterioration
lines: Pipework condition: [ ] Good [ ] Repair Required [ ] Replace Recommended

checklist.text: 9. Review and record any previous repairs or modifications to gas installations
lines: Previous works: [ ] None [ ] Logged in Gas Safety Certificate

checklist.text: 10. Confirm tenant information and property details are recorded for the certificate
